comment: Align platform broker telemetry signals to the signal matrix: emit isPlatformBrokerRequest whenever a request goes directly to the broker (including popup/redirect/ssoSilent served from a cached nativeAccountId, which skip the /authorize call), set isNativeBroker on broker-delivered results and terminal (no-fallback) broker errors while leaving it unset when the flow falls back to a web flow, and always record brokerErrorName/brokerErrorCode on broker failures [#8699](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8699)
